claims.claim: These findings have led medical societies to recommend GLP-1 receptor agonists with proven cardiovascular benefit.
The European Society of Cardiology guidelines now recommend GLP-1 drugs for patients with type 2 diabetes and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease to reduce cardiovascular events.
